title: Kaempferol inhibits colorectal cancer metastasis through circ_0000345 mediated JMJD2C/beta-catenin signalling pathway.
authors: Pu, Yunzhou; Han, Yicun; Ouyang, Yiran; Li, Haoze; Li, Ling; Wu, Xinnan; Yang, Liu; Gao, Jingdong; Zhang, Lei; Zhou, Jing; Ji, Qing; Song, Qing
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究山奈酚通过circ_0000345介导JMJD2C/β-catenin信号通路抑制结直肠癌转移，虽涉及分子对接但核心为肿瘤信号通路与湿实验，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Recurrence and metastasis are the main causes of disease deterioration in colorectal cancer (CRC) patients, yet efficient therapeutic strategies are lacking. Natural compounds for efficient antitumour therapeutics are becoming increasingly prominent. Kaempferol, one of the main components of flavonoids in plants, displays a variety of pharmacological activities. Our preliminary experiments suggested that kaempferol could inhibit CRC metastasis and is significantly associated with the beta-catenin signalling pathway. Moreover, we also defined the regulatory roles of JMJD2C in beta-catenin signalling in our previous work. PURPOSE: This study aims to reveal the mechanism by which kaempferol inhibits CRC progression and regulates the JMJD2C/beta-catenin signalling pathway. METHODS: The migratory capabilities of CRC cells after kaempferol intervention were measured by scratch wound healing and transwell assays. Circ_0000345 knockdown CRC stable cell lines were generated by lentivirus infection. The possible mechanism of kaempferol on circ_0000345 was verified by molecular-protein docking and verification program cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA). A dual luciferase reporter gene assay was carried out for the targeting relationship among circ_0000345, miR-205-5p and JMJD2C. Fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) was performed to determine the expression of circ_0000345 in tumour tissues. A pulmonary metastatic model of CRC in vitro was built to assess the antimetastatic effect and mechanism of kaempferol in vivo. RESULTS: In vitro, kaempferol inhibits the ability to migrate of CRC cells by reducing the activation of the JMJD2C/beta-catenin signalling pathway. MiR-205-5p is a key bridge for kaempferol to inhibit the expression of JMJD2C. The function of miR-205-5p is impeded by circ_0000345, which shows higher expression levels in human metastatic CRC tissues than nonmetastatic CRC tissues, and its formation is regulated by the RNA-binding proteins HNRNPK and HNRNPL. Mechanistically, kaempferol physically interacts with HNRNPK and HNRNPL to suppress JMJD2C by downregulating the expression of circ_0000345. In vivo, kaempferol suppresses CRC lung metastasis. Kaempferol inhibits the activation of JMJD2C/beta-catenin signalling through reducing the expression of circ_0000345 in the CRC lung metastasis model. CONCLUSION: Circ_0000345 enhances activation of the JMJD2C/beta-catenin signalling pathway through miR-205-5p to promote CRC metastasis. Kaempferol inhibits CRC metastasis through the circ_0000345-mediated JMJD2C/beta-catenin signalling pathway, and this effect is influenced as a direct consequence of the binding of kaempferol with HNRNPK and HNRNPL. This provides promising therapeutic and/or adjuvant agents for advanced CRC and sheds light on the multifaceted role of phytomedicine in cancer.
abstract_zh: 背景：复发和转移是结直肠癌（CRC）患者病情恶化的主要原因，然而目前缺乏有效的治疗策略。用于高效抗肿瘤治疗的自然化合物日益受到重视。山奈酚（kaempferol）是植物中黄酮类化合物的主要成分之一，具有多种药理活性。我们的初步实验表明，山奈酚可抑制CRC转移，并与β-catenin信号通路显著相关。此外，我们先前的工作还确定了JMJD2C在β-catenin信号通路中的调控作用。目的：本研究旨在揭示山奈酚抑制CRC进展并调控JMJD2C/β-catenin信号通路的机制。方法：通过划痕愈合实验和Transwell实验测定山奈酚干预后CRC细胞的迁移能力。通过慢病毒感染构建circ_0000345敲低的CRC稳定细胞系。通过分子-蛋白质对接和验证程序细胞热位移分析（CETSA）验证山奈酚对circ_0000345的可能机制。采用双荧光素酶报告基因实验检测circ_0000345、miR-205-5p和JMJD2C之间的靶向关系。通过荧光原位杂交（FISH）检测肿瘤组织中circ_0000345的表达。建立CRC体外肺转移模型，以评估山奈酚在体内的抗转移效果及机制。结果：在体外，山奈酚通过降低JMJD2C/β-catenin信号通路的激活来抑制CRC细胞的迁移能力。miR-205-5p是山奈酚抑制JMJD2C表达的关键桥梁。circ_0000345阻碍了miR-205-5p的功能，其在人类转移性CRC组织中的表达水平高于非转移性CRC组织，其形成受RNA结合蛋白HNRNPK和HNRNPL的调控。在机制上，山奈酚与HNRNPK和HNRNPL发生物理相互作用，通过下调circ_0000345的表达来抑制JMJD2C。在体内，山奈酚抑制CRC肺转移。在CRC肺转移模型中，山奈酚通过降低circ_0000345的表达来抑制JMJD2C/β-catenin信号通路的激活。结论：circ_0000345通过miR-205-5p增强JMJD2C/β-catenin信号通路的激活，从而促进CRC转移。山奈酚通过circ_0000345介导的JMJD2C/β-catenin信号通路抑制CRC转移，且该效应是山奈酚与HNRNPK和HNRNPL结合的直接结果。这为晚期CRC提供了有前景的治疗和/或辅助药物，并揭示了植物药物在癌症中的多方面作用。
